These are browse JPEG previews downloaded from the Sentinel Asia MSC Elsa 3 event page. They are not full-resolution or calibrated SAR products and must not be used as quad-polarimetric model input. The event page lists 28 May 2025 ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 Level 2.1 FBD right-looking products, with IMG HH browse imagery for frames 3420, 3430, 3440, 3450, and 3460. FBD denotes dual-pol acquisition (HH+HV), not quad-pol. Obtain the official product through JAXA G-Portal/AUIG2 or the event response data provider for actual backscatter layers and full metadata. Source: https://sentinel-asia.org/EO/2025/article20250525IN.html
